questions: Does each vertex appear exactly once across all N paths, or can vertices be reused across different paths?
Must the paths be vertex-disjoint, or can they share vertices as long as each edge is used at most once?
Is a path of length K defined as having K edges (so K+1 vertices) or K vertices (so K-1 edges)?
Can a path be a single vertex (if K=1), or must it have an edge (implying at least two vertices)?
Are the paths required to be simple (no repeated vertices within a path)?
Should the output be case-sensitive exactly 'Yes' and 'No', or are variations like 'YES'/'NO' acceptable?
If decomposition is impossible, is printing 'No' the only requirement, or should any additional output be provided?
Does the order of rows in matrix P matter, or is any valid arrangement acceptable?
